objective.statement: Discover at least 100 distinct high-value improvements to the estate by fanning out one seat per lens, then mechanically deduplicating and ranking what comes back.
objective.charter: Forty lens seats each read the estate through ONE perspective and report what they find. A grounding agent injects the shared grounding pack exactly once, before the fan-out, so forty seats do not each independently re-read the same files - that single injection was measured to remove roughly 60 to 90 redundant tool calls in one wave, and it prevents the split-brain where half the cohort works from a premise the other half already saw fixed. Two synthesisers then dedupe MECHANICALLY and rank; the duplicate rate is published rather than hidden, because a hundred ideas of which forty are trivial variants is not a hundred ideas. The evidence standard is split by lens: a grounded lens must cite file:line, an ideation lens must cite an external domain source and is explicitly told NOT to ground in the repository.
success_criteria: at least 100 ideas survive mechanical deduplication
the duplicate rate is computed and published alongside the count
the shared grounding pack was injected exactly once, before the fan-out
each lens's output meets ITS OWN evidence standard - file:line for grounded lenses, an external source for ideation lenses

sequence.custom_name: grounding agent produces ONE pinned digest and injects it to all lens seats before fan-out (read wide once, not 40 times)
deduplicate by similarity threshold in CODE, then rank; publish the duplicate rate

all_of.note: DIAL 1 of 3 - the 100-idea target, counted AFTER mechanical dedup. Cross-checked by the validator against targets.unique_ideas (SEM-007), so the gate and the target cannot silently drift apart.

all_of.producer: dedup tool: emits duplicates/raw alongside the surviving count
all_of.note: DIAL 2 of 3 - the design says the duplicate rate is REPORTED, so the gate is publication, not a threshold. If you would rather gate on a value, replace this leaf with duplicate_ratio <= 0.30 (a registry metric, so it needs no producer).

all_of.producer: injection log: asserts exactly one grounding-pack injection occurred before the first lens seat started
all_of.note: DIAL 3 of 3 - 'shared grounding pack injected once'. Zero injections means 40 seats each re-read the same files; more than one means the cohort split-brained on different premises.

metadata.title: Gem-hunt lens fan-out (40 lens seats + 1 grounding + 2 synthesisers = 43)
metadata.notes: WHEN TO USE: a wide discovery sweep over the estate where you do not yet know what you are looking for. WHEN NOT TO USE: to DECIDE anything - outcomes.allowed is deliberately limited to decision/dissent over a RANKED LIST, and never score these seats on output volume: the best verification work in the measured corpus is near the bottom on kilobytes per token, so a volume gate selects against exactly the behaviour worth having. The design's named dials are lens_list and dedup_threshold. EDITABLE DIALS: /participants/count/exact_n (the lens list length + 3), /targets/dedup/max_similarity and /targets/unique_ideas (dedup_threshold and the target - the same 0.8 appears in participants.duplicate_detection.max_similarity and targets.dedup.max_similarity, which are SEPARATELY enforced copies; keep them in sync), /budgets/tokens, /budgets/time_minutes. SEAT-COUNT DEFECT IN THE SOURCE DESIGN, resolved here: the C-X46 card says 'seats: 40' but its own role list totals 43 (lens_seat_x40 + ground_agent + synthesiser_x2), and its note records 'measured 43 agents'. Two of the three fields in that card say 43, so exact_n is 43 and the 40 is read as the lens-seat count only. This is the ONLY seat/role arithmetic mismatch among the sixteen designs in this slice (checked mechanically by _probe_seat_arithmetic.py). STOPPING (human form): unique_ideas >= 100 AND custom:duplicate_ratio_published == true AND custom:grounding_pack_injected_once == true. source_expression absent per the collision proven by _probe_sem_rule_collision.py.
